import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Calculate total revenue per product
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x=product_revenue.values, y=product_revenue.index, orient='h', palette='viridis')
plt.xlabel('Total Revenue ($)')
plt.ylabel('Product')
plt.title('Top 10 Products by Total Revenue')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
